description: CR 810.10a Mycosynth Fiend counts the opposing team's poison once
note: A Two-Headed Giant game with carol and dave's team on three poison counters, which each member holds (CR 810.10). Alice's Mycosynth Fiend gets +1/+1 for each poison counter her opponents have, and that is the number opposing teams have (CR 810.10a): three, not three per member, so the 2/2 is a 5/5. The control is the same team game without the variant, where carol's three and dave's three are their own and the Fiend is an 8/8.
